expected.raw_text: LLM-Anwendungen mit Amazon Bedrock in den produktiven Einsatz gebracht
systematischer Evaluation von Enterprise-KI-Anwendungen und KI-Pipelines

parsed.german_signal: sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) in Wort und Schrift notwendig
parsed.degree_signal: ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Informatik, Software Engineering, Ingenieurwesen o. ä.) oder eine vergleichbare technische Vorbildung
parsed.notes:
„Was dir bei der Arbeit helfen wird“ does not explicitly mark its items optional; on a literal reading, these candidate qualifications default to required.
KI-Entwicklung is provisionally mapped to ai-ml; this is broader than the taxonomy's explicit aliases and is flagged for review. It does not establish model training.
The degree has no stated level, so bachelor applies; vergleichbare technische Vorbildung is read as an accepted comparable qualification.
Technologies and practices appearing only under „Deine Aufgaben“ are excluded. Degree fields are not treated as skill requirements.
Code quality and Enterprise-Standards are read literally as requested technical practices, but have no matching taxonomy entries.
